name: Robert Gaudette
bio: Toronto-based filmmaker and co-founder of Nolia Studios, an AI-native production company.
bioMore: His short "A Face Only A Mother Could Love" won the $50,000 Grand Prix at Runway's AI Film Festival (AIFF) 2026 and the Reply AI Film Festival 2026 in Venice, made using Grok, Nano Banana, and Seedance.
